value.answer: Tomorrow in Denver looks cooler, with a high around 65°F, about 15 degrees below today's 80. Expect partly sunny skies, then a chance of showers moving in Tuesday evening (around 30% after 3 p.m.). It drops into the 30s to low 40s overnight, with light north-northeast wind gusting to about 17 mph.
